Pelicans beat Hawks to take the title

By Staff Reporter

The Port Elm Pelicans are regional champions after beating the Ridgefield Hawks 88 to 81 in Monday's final, a result that sent local sports fans into the streets.

Mina Okafor led the Pelicans with 31 points.

Harbor Arena was sold out, with 6,000 fans inside.

The win ends a 14-year wait for a championship.

Coach Dale Brennan said the title belonged to the whole city.
